subtasks.title: Write tests for plannerInstructions extraction and prepInstructions removal
subtasks.description:
Add a test in prompt_test.go that verifies Generate() with a planner AgentType produces output containing planner-specific markers. This is a behavioral smoke test ensuring the extraction didn't break the wiring in the switch statement at prompt.go:179.

Add TestGeneratePlannerIncludesPlannerInstructions to prompt_test.go:
- Create an Opts with Task (use model.Task with Title and Description set), Project (use model.Project), and AgentType set to model.AgentTypePlanner
- Call Generate(opts)
- Assert the output contains '## Instructions' (first section of plannerInstructions)
- Assert the output contains 'plan.json' (a key planner-specific term)
- Assert the output contains 'subtasks' (another key planner term)

Imports needed: testing, model (for AgentTypePlanner, Task, Project). Follow existing test patterns in prompt_test.go — the file already imports these packages.

Do NOT duplicate existing plannerInstructions() unit tests. This test specifically covers the Generate() call site wiring.

subtasks.title: Extract plannerInstructions to prompt_planner.go and delete prepInstructions
subtasks.description:
Structural refactoring: move plannerInstructions() from prompt.go to a new prompt_planner.go, and delete the dead prepInstructions() function.

Step 1: Create internal/prompt/prompt_planner.go
Follow the pattern from prompt_review_fixer.go:
- Package declaration: `package prompt`
- No imports needed (plannerInstructions has no imports — it calls depthScoringGuidance() which is in prompt_helpers.go, same package)
- Copy the function plannerInstructions() (lines 260-478 of prompt.go) including its doc comment at line 260
- The function signature is: func plannerInstructions() []string
- It returns a []string of prompt sections and calls depthScoringGuidance() at line 476

Step 2: Delete plannerInstructions from prompt.go
- Remove lines 259-478 (the blank line before the doc comment through the closing brace and trailing blank line)
- The line before (258) is the closing } of Generate(), and the next line should be the blank line before coderInstructions

Step 3: Delete prepInstructions from prompt.go
- After Step 2 renumbering, find the prepInstructions function (originally lines 794-899)
- Remove the entire function including its 4-line doc comment
- The function before it ends with } closing classifierInstructions
- The function after it starts with bugReportInstructions doc comment
- Leave a single blank line between classifierInstructions closing } and bugReportInstructions doc comment

Verification: After both changes, prompt.go should be ~613 lines. Well under the 800-line ceiling.

Call site: prompt.go line 179 (sections = append(sections, plannerInstructions()...)) does NOT change — same package-level function, now in prompt_planner.go.

Do NOT modify any test files.
